hazard: Unreported non-fatal anaphylaxis incidents in food businesses
theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Dylan Hill
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: In March, we will be meeting with representatives from other government departments (including the Department of Health and Social Care and Public Health England) and organisations involved in food allergy to discuss how we can better tackle the issue.
promises.summary: Meet with government departments and food allergy organisations to discuss tackling the issue

promises.quote: Our revised anaphylaxis draft protocol includes a referral form to inform Trading Standards of cases of anaphylactic reaction as a result of consuming food from commercial premises.
promises.summary: Updated protocol includes referral form to inform Trading Standards of anaphylactic reactions from commercial premises.

concerns.quote: Evidence was given before the Court of an incident within the same premises in September 2014 where a curry containing nuts was given to a customer who had requested a nut free curry. That customer had an anaphylactic reaction and was taken to hospital where he made a full recovery.
concerns.hazard: nut contamination in food served to allergic customers

concerns.quote: Evidence was also given that the Trading Standards department of the local council had not been told of this incident prior to the death of Mr Hill. Had they known, they would have arranged a priority visit.
concerns.hazard: lack of communication to Trading Standards about nut-related incidents

concerns.quote: In my opinion there is a risk that future deaths may occur unless cases of non fatal anaphylactic reactions caused by the ingestion of purchases from food business operatives are reported to those regulatory authorities responsible for the supervision and monitoring of food safety and hygiene.
concerns.hazard: unreported non-fatal anaphylaxis incidents in food businesses

concerns.quote: The question therefore arises as to whether the emergency services and health services within the area can work together to ensure that Trading Standards Departments are made aware of all anaphylaxis incidents relating to commercial premises so that the appropriate action can be taken as regards those premises.
concerns.hazard: delayed awareness of anaphylaxis incidents affecting commercial premises

reports.title: Celia Marsh: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: During the course of the inquest the evidence from a number of experts revealed matters giving rise to a concern
I was made aware that there needs to be better education both to doctors and to patients in risk groups to prevent future deaths
concerns.hazard: insufficient education on food allergy risks

concerns.quote: The post mortem examination should be prioritised. - At the post mortem examination: that stomach contents are taken and frozen to enable testing and that tissue samples are taken

To highlight, through public awareness and to the medical profession, that while the majority of food-allergic individuals are at very low risk of fatal reactions, a small subset of food-allergic individuals may be at significantly higher risk
The wording used on food products, and the public's understanding of these phrases in terms of implying the absence of a particular allergen, can be potentially misleading

links.explanation: Both reports concern the risk of undeclared allergens causing anaphylactic reactions and the need for better reporting of such incidents to authorities.
links.earlier_quote: Evidence was given that there are no procedures in place for such communications between the health services and Trading Standards in cases of non fatal anaphylactic reactions.
links.later_quote: - To establish a robust system of capturing and recording cases of anaphylaxis, and specifically, fatal and near-fatal anaphylaxis, to provide an early warning of the risk posed to allergic individual by products with undeclared allergen content.
links.promise_quote: Our revised anaphylaxis draft protocol includes a referral form to inform Trading Standards of cases of anaphylactic reaction as a result of consuming food from commercial premises.
